Home / Services / Emergency hotlines

Emergency contacts, without guessing.

The Municipality of Ibaan publishes a hotline page. Its contact list is served as a single image, so this guide links to the board and does not transcribe numbers it cannot verify as text.

For an emergency, use the official board linked below. This page is an index, not a dispatch service.

Why the numbers are not copied

A hotline list is the kind of record where a wrong digit matters. An image on a changing municipal page is not a stable text source for this guide, and copying numbers into a static page would create a second list that could drift out of date.

The official board stays the source of truth. If the municipality later publishes the same list as text, this page can index it with a checked date.
